assessment: All 15 retained PDF pages read and visually inspected, including nine figures, eleven tables, fourteen numbered equations, unnumbered normalisation/SF definitions and 65 bibliography entries. Main process diagrams, plot legends, raster tables and formula labels inspected. Independent checks cover printed cost identities, necessary cold-duty conditions, unit conversions and a CDF-inference counterexample. Missing supplementary inputs, underlying originals, Aspen/APEA cases, hazard models, weighted aggregation and author Monte Carlo reproduction remain open. The paper is not comprehensively complete.

sections.scope: Title, authors, abstract, licence and publication
sections.assessment: Zanobetti, Pio, Bucelli, Miani, Jafarzadeh and Cozzani; JCP 470 (2024), 143343; DOI 10.1016/j.jclepro.2024.143343. Received 26 May 2024, revised 31 July, accepted 2 August, online 5 August. CC-BY4.0. Abstract reports case-specific screening and operational environmental/normative sustainability indicators, not a full capture-to-retention inventory.

Read maritime emissions/policy claims, onshore CCS analogies, DNV projections, capture maturity, variable-load/membrane/cryogenic alternatives and novelty assertions. All65 direct references are mapped below. The underlying originals and projected lifecycle/negative-emissions claims remain unverified.

Four-stage possible/plausible/probable/best workflow. Technology/configuration/agent/operating-data checklist, common capture basis, highest-TRL benchmark and steady Aspen feasibility. Waste-heat and LNG-cold integration define the case; these are not generic carrier utility assumptions.

sections.scope: 2.3.Probable designs: four KPIs and domain winners
sections.assessment: Read VOO, NPC, GWI and HI definitions, parameters, units and boundaries. Pressure-change-unit volume is neglected for VOO but these units contribute to HI. An inherent hazard proxy represents the social pillar; no actual public-acceptance measurement or population risk model is supplied.

sections.scope: 2.4.Best design: OSI, SF, uncertainty and weights
sections.assessment: Internal division by maximum, weighted sums for IN/EG/HI/EW and orthogonal radar area. Uniform±20%KPI ranges,10^6 draws and10^6 weight quaterns in0–1 stated. Exact weights, dependence, renormalisation and seeds reside in unavailable data/supplement. These ranges are analyst/model assumptions, not measured confidence intervals.

Hyperion-class cruise ship,36 MW LNG lean-burn spark-ignition engine,6264 h/year and10-day voyages. Full-load exhaust design; LNG, LH2–PEMFC and LNH3–SOFC benchmarks. Captured CO2 compressed/liquefied using LNG cold, stored as saturated liquid. Full ship layout/loads and benchmark cases are not retained.

MEA absorption, chilled-bead desublimation, two-stage membranes and zeolite13 X PSA. All target95%capture; Table7 avoidance/duties differ. Reference22.6 bar storage, LNG139–293 K/1.28 MW cold and5 K approach. Only AS/A3 C pass the stated energy integration; main tables do not supply full stream/utility balances.

Figures5/6 and Table9 read. AS wins technological/environmental KPIs; A3 C economic/social. Individualist/equal weights favour A3 C; environmental perspectives favour AS. Stated rank-inversion probabilities require original paired draws and weighting procedure for verification.

Five-system comparison combines baseline propulsion and OCCS indicators. Main Table10 and plot axes/legends inspected. Zero-carbon H2/NH3 is an operational boundary. SF/OSI rankings are not lifecycle-GHG measures; CDF noncrossing alone cannot prove zero paired AS/A3 C rank inversions.

Read all technology strengths/limits, ship layout/tonnage/secondary-load limitations and future risk mitigation. Incentives, public awareness, port infrastructure, standards and green corridors are recommendations rather than demonstrated current access or quantified benefits.

Read conclusions, all CRediT roles, no competing interest declaration and data available on request. Funding NEST PE00000021/CUPJ33 C22002890007 acknowledged. Publisher supplement is explicitly linked at the DOI; contents not obtained or reviewed. No author contact sent.

21 entries beginp14,44 p15. Exact DOI match scan finds no original among the92-paper catalogue; CEMCAP D3.2 cited here is not the retained D4.2 utility report. Bibliography reading, URI extraction and related local calculations are not underlying-source verification.

equations.check: All terms are equipment volumes, m3. Pressure-change volume is neglected by Table1. A volume sum omits layout clearances, piping and ship mass/stability constraints; not a complete integration design.
Constant annual OPEX and fixed discount/lifetime assumptions. At8%/25 years the present-value factor is10.67477619. No time-varying prices, replacement schedule or salvage term shown.
Preserve divisor. This is an estimation factor, not an energy duty. Original Feenstra methodology remains unchecked.
Same monetary basis required. Detailed actual cost components are missing.
Indirect factor14% of direct plant cost, not14% of equipment cost.
Together Eqs3–6 give CAPEX=2.86425 TEC. Independently reconstructed without replacing the source costing convention.
Purchased equipment costs estimated with APEA. Individual equipment design/cost outputs and cost-year basis missing.

This is3% of annualised CAPEX. Multiplication by Eq2 annuity factor gives PV(FOPEX)=0.03 CAPEX and NPC excluding VOPEX=1.03 CAPEX. Do not silently replace by3% of CAPEX per year. Full NPC requires missing VOPEX and equipment data.

Operational CO2-flow indicator. A factor of one does not add upstream fuels, methane slip, other GHGs, assets, solvent production or downstream geological retention. Units must match t/year inputs and kt_eq/year plots.

Counts uncaptured exhaust plus utility-related direct CO2. Captured CO2 is not independently demonstrated permanently retained. Baseline/auxiliary combustion boundaries and later Eq14 nomenclature require exact case data.

EF0.413 kg/kWh times kW gives kg/hour. To t/year multiply by operating hours and divide1000; plots use kt/year. One kW at6264 h/year gives2.587032 t/year. Annual factor is not explicit in the printed expression.

Credit factor1/year times area m2 gives m2/year if distance is m as defined in prose. Table4 prints distance m2, a conflicting label. Maximum scenario per LOC, then frequency/area sum; no population, occupancy or vulnerability model. This is not a probability of injury or measured acceptability.

Lower is better; NI internally normalised by maximum within alternatives. Weight vectors, sum-to-one enforcement and Monte Carlo dependence/renormalisation are not supplied. Four perspectives are normative preferences, not occurrence probabilities.

Printed fraction needs percent scaling. e_EG previously means exhaust before subtracting e_capt; Eq14 contains no explicit e_capt. Whether e_EG here denotes residual post-capture exhaust needs clarification. Preserve notation; do not derive per-captured duties or force equivalence to Figure7 total-system GWI.

equations.printed: OPEX=FOPEX+VOPEX; VOPEX=sum of utility/raw-material quantity times price (described).
equations.check: Actual quantities/prices are deferred to the supplement. No complete cost or utility inventory is reconstructed from this description.

For four orthogonal radii, polygon area=0.5Σ r_i r_(i+1), full chart area2, so SF=0.25Σ products. The printed example0.490/2=.245 closes. Normalisation and radar ordering affect interpretation. Full five-system OSIs are missing; author SF is not reproduced.

variables: AS amine scrubbing; A3C advanced cryogenic capture; MS membrane separation; PSA pressure-swing adsorption. These are selected configurations, not every possible technology variant.
Common95% exhaust capture differs from85.7/77.5% case avoidance and from total-system GWI reductions. No denominator substitution or permanence credit.
VOO m3; tank filling≤90%; pumps/compressors neglected only for the volume KPI. Ten-day storage basis is not a validated port schedule or annual capacity.
CAPEX/FCI/TDPC/TIPC/TEC/EC in euros; OPEX euro/year. i=.08, n=25years. Printed FOPEX is3% of annualised capital, not ordinary3%CAPEX/year.
PIF_GW=1; e_EG/e_capt/e_dir labelled tCO2/year; EF=.413kg/kWh, electrical loads kW, annual operation6264h. GWI graphs kt_eq/year. Explicit hours and mass conversion required.
Waste heat supplies the AS reboiler; LNG139–293K provides1.28MW cold. Reference22.6bar saturated-liquid storage and5K exchanger approach. Pressure basis and complete stream states missing.
Table7 duties MJ/kgCO2 AVOIDED, not per captured tonne. MS/PSA n.a. duty entries remain null, not numeric zero. Their avoidance is reported0%, without raw negative/unclipped results.
MS0.95bar denotes transmembrane difference, not absolute pressure. Different separation/regeneration/storage pressures cannot be merged.
HI uses LOC credit factors1/year, squared damage radius and worst scenario per LOC. Distance prose saysm; Table4 labelsm2. HI m2/year is a hazard proxy, not social acceptance or individual risk.
NI and OSI are relative scores; weights depend on IN/EG/HI/EW perspectives. SF is a radar-area score; it is not kgCO2e or a unique physical objective.
Uniform±20%KPI ranges and one million draws are assumed uncertainty, not empirical confidence calibration. Weight sampling, dependence, normalisation, seeds and joint records unavailable.
36MW full-load design,6264h/year and10days/voyage. Lack of secondary-load/time/layout/tonnage detail acknowledged; full-load design does not independently validate every lower-load heat/cold balance.
LH2 and NH3 green-fuel benchmarks have100% operational avoidance in Table10. Fuel production, electricity origin, ammonia N2O and hydrogen supply leakage are not established by the zero-carbon label.

claims.claim: OCCS can support maritime targets; literature projects substantial or negative lifecycle emissions.
claims.assessment: Historical policy and external projections remain attributed. No original IMO/DNV or cited technology paper was independently checked in this record.

claims.claim: Only AS and A3 C are feasible for this cruise-ship case.
claims.assessment: Main cold-duty and temperature bounds explain MS/PSA failures. Passing total duty does not reproduce the detailed Aspen/pinch case or exclude all future membrane/PSA variants.

claims.claim: Full-load design ensures OCCS energy needs throughout the voyage.
claims.assessment: Source claim requires variable-load thermal and auxiliary data for independent validation. The authors acknowledge missing secondary-load/time detail. No automatic voyage-wide proof adopted.

claims.claim: 95%capture gives85.7%AS/77.5%A3 C avoidance and the listed duties.
claims.assessment: Preserve all source quantities and per-avoided basis. Eq14 e_EG meaning and baseline/captured/utility flows are unavailable; no complete energy or avoidance reproduction.

claims.claim: A3 C volume about2.2%higher, NPC about16%lower, GWI about1.6×AS.
claims.assessment: Plots and component legends inspected; no exact raw KPI values or complete APEA/utility outputs. These remain author case outputs.

claims.claim: AS hazard KPI about15×A3 C; social/economic priorities favour A3 C.
claims.assessment: Hazard-area proxy and selected LOC assumptions, not measured social acceptance or accident risk. Underlying hazard/release/consequence inputs missing.

claims.claim: INASI ratio2.5; EG/HI favour AS, EW favours A3 C.
claims.assessment: Table9 values and colour coding support reported base rankings; ratio.95/.38=2.5. Missing weights/raw KPIs prevent independent OSI construction.

claims.claim: MC rank inversion~5%HI/~3%EG; sampled weights~18.5%A3 C worse.
claims.assessment: Source-reported conditional probabilities only. Uniform inputs, constraints, dependence and code need verification; no empirical likelihood inference.

claims.claim: OCCS increases volume versus H2/NH3 and capital/cost versus BAU.
claims.assessment: Five-system plots use combined propulsion+OCCS scope, unlike OCCS-only Figure5. Raw additive boundaries and exact values need supplementary data.

claims.claim: All alternatives lower environmental impact≥61%; OCCS GWI reduction up to68%.
claims.assessment: Operational CO2 indicator, not full lifecycle mitigation. Not equated with Table7 capture/avoidance or SF percentage improvement.

claims.claim: H2 has at least2.7×lower SF; AS SF about6%lower than A3 C; H2 reduction up to76%.
claims.assessment: Normative relative score derived from weights and normalisation. Full five-system OSI table unavailable; no independently reproduced SF or GHG interpretation.

claims.claim: Noncrossing Figure9 CDFs mean no AS/A3 C rank inversion.
claims.assessment: Marginal CDF order alone cannot establish paired order. Analyst independent uniforms U[0,.8] and U[.2,1] have noncrossing CDFs yet P(A>B)=.28125. This is a counterexample to the inference, not an estimate of author simulation outcomes; paired traces required.

claims.claim: OCCS/ammonia rank inversion can reach30%; LNG is least sustainable.
claims.assessment: Conditional source result within selected scenarios/uncertainty/weights. Original joint samples missing; no universal or empirically calibrated ranking.

claims.claim: Future improvements/incentives/ports/green corridors enable wider OCCS adoption.
claims.assessment: Recommendations and early-design conclusions. Complete ship layout, tonnage, variable loads, offloading chain and risk mitigation remain future work, not current engineering/commercial permission.
